name: Pull-Up (Neutral Grip, Bodyweight)
instructions: Hang from neutral-grip handles with arms straight.
Pull your chest toward the handles.
longevityNotes: Pulling strength balances all the forward-reaching of daily life and protects the shoulders and upper back. A strong back is one of the best predictors of staying active and independent.
overview: A pull-up with palms facing each other, which is often easier on the shoulders and elbows.
